name: Pyro Treasure Compass
description:
A compass that can be used in Natlan to search for nearby treasure and relevant clues.
Amidst the turmoil and strife that wrack the land, many treasures throughout the vast Nation of Pyro have gone unaccounted for, all trace of their whereabouts lost.
fullDescription: A handy tool used to locate nearby chests and relevant clues. In the land of perpetual conflict, there is a simple rule when it comes to finding treasure: Finders, keepers.
